payload.text: ST0001 ubuntu CI (vc, run 41591508539 at 92105af): macOS is all green, bats included, but ubuntu fails 3 replay cases, sync-apply-plan, sync-link-all-names and sync-link-apply. Each fails with 'No such file or directory (os error 2)' from the harness, not a golden diff: all three write to Contacts, and the sidecar is built only on macOS (tests/cli.rs reaches for pplr-contacts beside the binary). Fix under AC-00.7: on Linux a Contacts write exits non-zero naming why, and the replay skips those cases there by name. It lands as its own small commit, measured, first-ready against WP14 and cc's WP11 commit 3 (all three touch tests/cli.rs). Then expect the bats layer (todo 1)
